name: Littlestone Dimension of the Cube–Half-interval Product
details: For $m\ge1,n\ge2$. Block and prefix formulas hold for fixed integer $k\ge2$; the general block catalogue entry uses $k>2$. Asymptotic orders refer to $n\to\infty$ with $m,k$ fixed.
proof: There are $2^m n$ concepts, so distinct realizers of the leaves of a depth-$d$ complete shattered tree imply $d\le m+\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor$. Query the $m$ cube coordinates in a fixed order, then use a balanced threshold-search tree of depth $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor$ on the $n$ ordered endpoints. Independence of the factors realizes every branch and attains the bound.
references: Direct finite product calculation; independent exact regression in sync/verify_cube_halfinterval_trees.py.
